# signing domain

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:signingDomain`](gmeow-signingDomain.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/signingDomain>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The domain asserted by a signature (e.g. the DKIM d= tag).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:signingDomain`](gmeow-signingDomain.md) from [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the domain a signature asserts on behalf of — the DKIM d= tag and like domain-scoped signing claims.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the signer agent (that is [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md)) and for the verification outcome ([`gmeow:verificationStatus`](gmeow-verificationStatus.md)); the domain is the claimed signing authority, not the identity or the result. It is functional.

### How to use

- Attach the domain literal to the signature; the email-wire detail (Authentication-Results, relay hops) lives in the email extension, while this generic seam carries the asserted domain.

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:signingDomain`](gmeow-signingDomain.md) "example.com".
